test.name: Protocol providers can be applied after heavy concurrent updates
Concurrent request recording is atomic and does not throw under load
Open model uses configured expected RPS and uses open duration in report config
Closed model derives expected RPS from expectedTotalRequests / hold duration
Report includes protocol providers and cancellation completion reason
